nodes.label: HypoRefine — a method that grounds data-driven hypothesis generation (via HypoGeniC) with literature-based insights thro
nodes.result: HypoRefine — a method that grounds data-driven hypothesis generation (via HypoGeniC) with literature-based insights through a collaborative agent architecture that refines and maintains a shared hypothesis pool — outperforms literature-only, data-only, and few-shot baselines on out-of-distribution generalization across five social-science classification tasks (15.75%, 3.37%, and 8.97% gains, respectively).
nodes.paper: Literature Meets Data: A Synergistic Approach to Hypothesis Generation

nodes.label: Automatic evaluation across five datasets shows that integrating literature-based and data-driven hypothesis generation
nodes.result: Automatic evaluation across five datasets shows that integrating literature-based and data-driven hypothesis generation yields the best generalizability, measured by out-of-distribution accuracy, across all task and model configurations, and that the generated hypotheses transfer effectively to different inference models.
nodes.paper: Literature Meets Data: A Synergistic Approach to Hypothesis Generation

nodes.label: DN-Hypo-Pipeline — an LLM-driven workflow that identifies underlying laws, theories, and principles from a paper's expla
nodes.result: DN-Hypo-Pipeline — an LLM-driven workflow that identifies underlying laws, theories, and principles from a paper's explanandum and reconstructs novel, yet-to-be-verified scientific hypotheses from existing literature using scientific explanations as prior knowledge.
nodes.paper: DN-Hypo-Pipeline: An AI-Driven Workflow for Hypothesis Generation via Large Language Models and Scientific Explanations

nodes.label: Novel algorithms derived from LLM-generated hypotheses that outperform baseline models from highly cited data science pa
nodes.result: Novel algorithms derived from LLM-generated hypotheses that outperform baseline models from highly cited data science papers, providing end-to-end experimental validation of AI-generated scientific hypotheses.
nodes.paper: DN-Hypo-Pipeline: An AI-Driven Workflow for Hypothesis Generation via Large Language Models and Scientific Explanations

nodes.label: HypoGeniC — an iterative hypothesis generation algorithm for LLMs inspired by the upper confidence bound (UCB) multi-arm
nodes.result: HypoGeniC — an iterative hypothesis generation algorithm for LLMs inspired by the upper confidence bound (UCB) multi-armed bandit framework — generates and refines data-grounded hypotheses by maintaining a wrong-example bank and a reward-driven exploitation-exploration tradeoff, enabling LLMs to handle arbitrarily large training sets without long-context limitations.
nodes.paper: Hypothesis Generation with Large Language Models

nodes.label: Interpretable hypothesis-based classifiers derived from LLM-generated hypotheses outperform few-shot in-context learning
nodes.result: Interpretable hypothesis-based classifiers derived from LLM-generated hypotheses outperform few-shot in-context learning by up to 31.7% and exceed supervised learning baselines (RoBERTa, Llama-2-7B) on two challenging real-world datasets, with hypotheses that transfer robustly across different LLMs and out-of-distribution test sets.
nodes.paper: Hypothesis Generation with Large Language Models

nodes.label: LLM-generated hypotheses about real-world classification tasks both corroborate human-verified theories from existing li
nodes.result: LLM-generated hypotheses about real-world classification tasks both corroborate human-verified theories from existing literature and surface novel, previously undocumented insights — including findings that contradict established feature-engineering results.
nodes.paper: Hypothesis Generation with Large Language Models

nodes.label: A hybrid framework (LLMCG) combining LLM-based causal relation extraction from large psychology literature corpora with
nodes.result: A hybrid framework (LLMCG) combining LLM-based causal relation extraction from large psychology literature corpora with link prediction on the resulting causal graph generates novel psychological hypotheses that match expert (doctoral scholar) quality in novelty and outperform LLM-only hypothesis generation.
nodes.paper: Automating psychological hypothesis generation with AI: when large language models meet causal graph

nodes.label: A formal mathematical decomposition of chemistry hypothesis discovery into three executable subtasks — retrieving inspir
nodes.result: A formal mathematical decomposition of chemistry hypothesis discovery into three executable subtasks — retrieving inspirations, composing hypotheses from inspirations, and ranking hypotheses — provides a tractable reformulation of an otherwise intractable scientific discovery problem.
nodes.paper: MOOSE-Chem: Large Language Models for Rediscovering Unseen Chemistry Scientific Hypotheses

nodes.label: LLMs appear to encode latent scientific knowledge associations — pairs of concepts whose connection enables novel hypoth
nodes.result: LLMs appear to encode latent scientific knowledge associations — pairs of concepts whose connection enables novel hypothesis generation — that have not yet been explicitly recognized by human scientists, as evidenced by surprisingly high out-of-distribution inspiration retrieval accuracy.
nodes.paper: MOOSE-Chem: Large Language Models for Rediscovering Unseen Chemistry Scientific Hypotheses

nodes.label: KG-CoI (Knowledge Grounded Chain of Ideas) — a system that integrates structured knowledge from knowledge graphs into LL
nodes.result: KG-CoI (Knowledge Grounded Chain of Ideas) — a system that integrates structured knowledge from knowledge graphs into LLM hypothesis generation via KG-guided context retrieval, KG-augmented chain-of-idea generation, and KG-supported hallucination detection — improves the accuracy and factual grounding of scientifically generated hypotheses.
nodes.paper: Improving Scientific Hypothesis Generation with Knowledge Grounded Large Language Models

nodes.label: A spectrum of integration methods for combining experts, LLMs, and data-driven approaches in causal hypothesis generatio
nodes.result: A spectrum of integration methods for combining experts, LLMs, and data-driven approaches in causal hypothesis generation, ranging from purely knowledge-driven to purely data-driven, with varying degrees of interaction between sources.
nodes.paper: Large language models for causal hypothesis generation in science

nodes.label: GPT4-generated hypotheses about novel synergistic pairs of FDA-approved non-cancer drugs targeting the MCF7 breast cance
nodes.result: GPT4-generated hypotheses about novel synergistic pairs of FDA-approved non-cancer drugs targeting the MCF7 breast cancer cell line are experimentally validated in the laboratory, with three out of twelve first-round combinations and three out of four second-round combinations achieving synergy scores above positive controls.
nodes.paper: Scientific hypothesis generation by large language models: laboratory validation in breast cancer treatment

nodes.label: ResearchAgent — an LLM-powered system that automatically identifies novel research problems, proposes methods, and desig
nodes.result: ResearchAgent — an LLM-powered system that automatically identifies novel research problems, proposes methods, and designs experiments by augmenting a core paper with an academic-graph neighbourhood and an entity-centric knowledge store, then iteratively refines the output via feedback from collaborative ReviewingAgents.
nodes.paper: ResearchAgent: Iterative Research Idea Generation over Scientific Literature with Large Language Models

nodes.label: HypoBench — a benchmark spanning 194 datasets across 7 real-world and 5 synthetic tasks — enables systematic evaluation
nodes.result: HypoBench — a benchmark spanning 194 datasets across 7 real-world and 5 synthetic tasks — enables systematic evaluation of hypothesis generation methods along three dimensions: practical utility (explanatory power), generalizability (in-domain vs. out-of-domain splits), and ground-truth hypothesis discovery rate.
nodes.paper: HypoBench: Towards Systematic and Principled Benchmarking for Hypothesis Generation

nodes.label: Controlled synthetic datasets with programmatically varied difficulty (via logistic regression or decision-tree data-gen
nodes.result: Controlled synthetic datasets with programmatically varied difficulty (via logistic regression or decision-tree data-generating processes) reveal that hypothesis discovery rates collapse sharply as task complexity grows — best-performing model–method combinations recover only 38.8% of ground-truth hypotheses at high difficulty, quantifying a concrete ceiling for current approaches.
nodes.paper: HypoBench: Towards Systematic and Principled Benchmarking for Hypothesis Generation
